body: Worker trap (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-30, my own miss on w-214437118fcf GREEN2, Mac run test-a147a75a, which failed in 1 s and executed no test). `cargo test` accepts only ONE TESTNAME before `--`. Several libtest filters must go AFTER `--`: `cargo test --bin termal -- tests::a tests::b tests::c`. Writing `cargo test --bin termal tests::a tests::b` fails with "error: unexpected argument 'tests::b' found". When you hand a runner a multi-filter command, put the filters after `--` and check the line before sending it. A wrong command form costs a slot and a recorded failed run.
